g.text: TIER 1 — edge controllers, one per floor
infinity-magic · amd64 · standbys (same image and spec)

text.tspan: Per floor, every 5 s: threshold rule + isolation forest
(ONNX, p50 18 ms on the Pi). Releases its own floor's doors
in the same tick. Heartbeat every 10 s; the standby promotes
after 30 s of silence. Works without server, broker or LLM.
